transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. I've started... losing my place a lot. Like when I'm scheduling appointments, or... working on the lobby displays. My mind just sort of slips off track. I guess I just get busy thinking about... what I might have overlooked. So, um, that's what made me come in.
Are you experiencing these difficulties with your mind slipping off track outside of work as well?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess I haven't paid that much attention to it at home. It's mostly just... at work where I notice it being a problem.
Do you feel anxious or worried when your mind slips off track at work?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I just... I worry a lot. About normal things, mostly. Like the schedules at work, or... bills, or if I messed up some paperwork. It just feels like... if I make one little mistake, it's going to turn into this huge issue. So, yeah... I guess I do feel worried.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind, even when you try to stop thinking about them?

Um... yeah, I suppose they do. I try to tell myself, you know, 'Sunny, it’s handled.' But... the thought just keeps looping anyway. And then, I don't know, pretty soon I've just gone from one concern to another. I just end up... checking all the details in my head, over and over. Even when I try to stop.
Have you been experiencing any physical symptoms like headaches or stomachaches lately?
Um... no, not really. I mean... maybe a headache sometimes, but... nothing out of the ordinary, I don't think.
Do you feel like these repeating thoughts are unreasonable or irrational?
Um... I don't know. Not really. I mean... they're just things I need to keep track of, mostly. So... I guess they make sense to me. I wouldn't really call them unreasonable.
Are these worries and repeating thoughts affecting your relationships with friends or family?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so, anyway. I mean... I mostly just keep it to myself. So... it doesn't really come up with my family or anything. Things are fine.
Do you feel like you need to do certain things over and over, like checking or cleaning, to feel okay or to prevent something bad from happening?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't really do anything like that. I just... I just have the thoughts, I guess. But I don't need to do anything over and over.
Do you feel like these worries and thoughts are causing you a lot of distress?
Um... I guess so? I mean, it's just... stressful, sometimes. But it's not... I wouldn't say it's a lot. Just normal stress, I think.
Are you having trouble completing tasks or meeting deadlines at work due to these worries and repeating thoughts?

Um... well, I'm still showing up and getting through the day. I wouldn't say I'm having trouble, really. It's just... maybe scheduling takes me a little longer now. I just find myself double-checking things a lot. And... sometimes I have to redo parts of the lobby displays... just because I lose track of what I was arranging. But I still get it all done.
Are you finding it harder to enjoy things you used to enjoy, because of these worries and thoughts?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I still do the things I usually do. I don't think it's changed how much I like them or anything. It's just... I'm just a bit stressed, that's all.
Are you finding it harder to function in your daily life because of these worries and thoughts?

Um... I think I already said this, but... I'm still getting through the day fine. It's just... like I mentioned, the scheduling takes a bit longer with all the double-checking. And... the lobby displays. But I'm still functioning. It's just... taking a little more effort, I guess.
Are you avoiding social situations because of your worries or thoughts?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I talk to people all day at the front desk, so... I haven't stopped going places or anything. I just stick to my normal routine.
How long have you been experiencing these worries and repeating thoughts?

Um... I guess it's been about... nine months now. It started after... well, there was an incident where I was detained overnight, and... some paperwork got mixed up. Ever since then, it's just been... like this.
Did the worries and repeating thoughts start immediately after the incident where you were detained overnight, or was there some time in between?
Um... I don't really know. I guess... it's hard to say exactly when it started. I just know it's been happening since then.
Did the incident where you were detained overnight feel traumatic to you?
Um... I don't know if I'd use the word traumatic. It was just... really stressful. I don't really like thinking about it too much.
Do you think the incident where you were detained overnight contributed to your current worries and repeating thoughts?
Um... I guess it's possible. I'm really not sure. I just... I know it all kind of happened around the same time. I haven't really tried to figure out if one caused the other.
Do you think the worries and repeating thoughts would stop or greatly diminish if the issues related to your work, like the schedules and lobby displays, were completely resolved?
I don't really know. Um... maybe? I haven't really thought about it like that. I just know they're there.
Do you think your worries and repeating thoughts are primarily about the stress of being detained overnight and its aftermath?
I'm not really sure. Um... I don't think it's just about that. It's just... a lot of things, I guess.
Do you think your worries and repeating thoughts started as a direct reaction to being detained overnight?
Um... yeah, I suppose. It's been going on for about nine months now. Just... ever since that overnight detention, and the whole paperwork mix-up with it. So... yeah, I guess that's when it started.
